definitions.explanation: A tiny wingless jumping insect that lives on mammals and birds and feeds on their blood; in daily life mostly met as a pest on dogs and cats.

examples.english: To get rid of the cat's fleas.

examples.japanese: ノミ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{何十倍|なんじゅうばい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{跳|と}べる→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧。
examples.english: A flea can jump dozens of times its own body height.

notes:
WATCH OUT: Same reading as のみ, a chisel (written {鑿|のみ}, usually in kana), and as the particle のみ (only). Writing the insect in katakana keeps them apart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ノミ{取|と}り: flea removal; ノミ{取|と}り⟦{首輪|くびわ}→首輪：14637_kubiwa⟧: a flea collar
- ノミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市|いち}→市：10013_ichi⟧: flea market (a translation of the French; ⟦フリーマーケット→フリーマーケット：09804_furiimaaketto⟧ is the everyday word)
- ノミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧: a faint heart, a timid person (literally, a flea's heart)
- ノミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧: a couple in which the wife is bigger than the husband (from female fleas being larger)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦シラミ→シラミ：32663_shirami⟧: louse
- ⟦ダニ→ダニ：32586_dani⟧: mite, tick
